seo.title: About ODD — one platform, two ways in
seo.description: A co-creation platform built in Helsinki, on a mission to bring creativity and business together — not as opposites politely sharing a stage, but as one working system.

panels.alt: An ODD performance, lit from behind
panels.title: This is ODD.
panels.body: A co-creation platform built in Helsinki, on a mission to bring creativity and business together — not as opposites politely sharing a stage, but as one working system.

panels.alt: Motion-blurred crowd at an ODD event
panels.title: Creative work and business work almost never happen in the same room.
panels.body: Festivals talk to artists. Conferences talk to founders. Studios talk to whoever's already inside. ODD exists because the most interesting things happen when those rooms are the same room.

panels.title:
Business gets in. Creatives get in.
Everyone ends up in the same place.
panels.body: Buy a ticket or pitch a project — start on the business side. Join the program or ask about membership — start on the creative side. Either door, same floor: the work happens together, in the open, in Helsinki.

panels.title: Helsinki's creative economy, built in public.
panels.body: Not a festival with a side program. Not a conference with a party after. One platform, run by New Nordic Way rf, growing a little more honest every year it runs.
